# Issue tracker

**As of 2026-11-13.** The tracker state is read live from GitHub
(fetched 2026-11-13 18:22 UTC, kept in `data/progress-snapshot.json`); the
counts of requirements, tests and lines are read from the rustinfer tree at commit 04a2a26 2026-11-13.
Coverage is not measured here: it is the final test run of GitHub PR #21's merge-readiness checklist (`cargo llvm-cov --workspace --all-features`, after the rebase), 2026-11-12. The [progress](progress.html) page counts the rows
below with every other tracker on the site; the [roadmap](roadmap.html) is the same sequence as prose.
The project moved from Codeberg to [github.com/itej89/rustinfer](https://github.com/itej89/rustinfer) on 2026-11-12 (ADR-008,
[decisions](decisions.html)); the issues kept their numbers, the Codeberg pull requests and Actions
runs did not move and are listed below as history.

## Release 1 issues

The ids are `R1-n` for [GitHub issue](https://github.com/itej89/rustinfer/issues) #n. The status is derived, not typed: **Done** with its
date when the issue is closed; **In review** with the date its pull request opened; **In
progress** when its branch exists on GitHub; otherwise **Not started**, with `waits on #n` for
each blocker still open. The bold **Open** marks the item everything else waits on: the first
open issue in dependency order whose blockers are all closed. Bodies are drafted in
`docs/planning/issues/` in the tree.
